verdicts.flaw_description: The claim is about purchases, but every segment reports only 'cart additions' (6, 4, 7 and 5 percent above the prior month) - adding to a cart happens before the checkout page is even reached, so no purchase outcome is measured at all.

'Throughput at each site fell by half against the earlier quarter, and every stack logged here fired in step with site output' - a 50 percent drop in firing fully explains particulate falling 8-14 percent without any filter effect.
The claim is about restoring shoulder range of motion, but every ward reports shoulder pain scores (14, 11, 16 and 9 points lower); pain relief is a different quantity from measured range of motion.

'House air temperature ran a full four degrees above the earlier sowing, and every lot sat on an open bench, taking the house air directly' - the warmer house, not the coating, plausibly accounts for the 6-11 point germination gain in all four lots.
